inspection_scope: Full memo text and all page renders; original workbook input and source labels, historical totals after LibreOffice recalculation, live formulas and main underwriting rendering. Automatic base and perturbation checks in audit/.
summary: All 39 requested fields and all ten workbook checks pass. Missing insurance evidence is clearly labeled provisional. The memo confuses sizing-rate debt service with the contractual payment after IO, misplaces lease expiry near loan maturity and clips source tables.
